_comment: OWNER FORCE-BUYABLE OVERRIDES (DLR). fever_scrape.py's plan_status() live-reads a Fever plan's session-selector blob to decide buyability, but Fever sometimes serves NO selector for a real, on-sale session (the same removal that made Candlelight vanish 2026-08-17). The auto check then reports 'off sale' and the unbuyable-drop pass DELETES a genuine bookable show, losing the commission. List a (sku, date) here ONLY when the owner has BROWSER-CONFIRMED it is on sale: fever_scrape then never drops it AND writes the date into fever_availability.json so build_site's own fever_unbuyable() gate keeps it on every deploy too. Remove an entry the moment the show is genuinely past or sold out. Format: {sku: [ISO dates]}.
_678230_why: GRUPO FIRME, Malaga Forum, Sun 20 Sep 2026. BROWSER-CONFIRMED on feverup.com/m/678230 on 2026-09-16: the session 'dom 20 sept 20:00' offers FIVE tiers and only ONE is sold out - Super VIP 90,00 EUR, Terraza VIP 40,00 EUR AGOTADO, Preferencial 85,00 EUR, Platino 65,00 EUR, General 45,00 EUR, each of the four with a live quantity stepper. General 45,00 EUR matches the calendar's 'Desde 45 EUR'. WHY IT WAS DROPPED: FEVER_BUYABLE holds sku 678230 with an EMPTY set of dates, so fever_unbuyable() returned True for every date and the card never shipped - the same shape as Candlelight Disney Love Songs (sku 646736, two entries above). Found by Sofia, 2026-09-16: 'I don't see Grupo Firme in the event list, only in the Marquee.' THE MARQUEE TILE WAS STILL PROMOTING IT, so the site was advertising a show its own gate had hidden from the calendar. Remove this entry when the show is past or genuinely sold out. SEPARATE, STILL OPEN: an EMPTY date set means the availability scraper found the plan and extracted zero sessions - that is a scraper failure, not a Fever state, and it will recur on other SKUs.
